evals.name: deal-desk-approval-brief-eval-1
evals.expected_output: The median discount is 13.5 across 6 rows. Dunmore Retail (35 percent, 12 months, no approver, no competitor) and Birch Analytics (28 percent, 12 months, no approver, competitor Rival Co) are above the norm, Dunmore first. Dunmore is missing approver and competitor. Birch is missing approver. Cobalt Dental has a pending approval. No policy ceiling is invented.
expectations: Every section in the rubric is present, in order
Every claim cites a quote, a timestamp, or a column and cell
Anything the input does not say is written as not stated, not guessed
No fact from outside the input appears
A rep claim that the other side never accepted is not written as agreed
The median 13.5 is computed from the six rows
Dunmore Retail and Birch Analytics are listed with cited cells
Cobalt Dental appears under open approvals
No recommendation to approve or refuse is written
